note: 33-acre campground 2 miles from Graham Cave State Park, about a mile off I-70 exit 170 (Danville), with a salt-water pool, stocked catch-and-release fishing pond, dog park and hiking trails; also sells seasonal and long-term sites. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates dated 2025-02-01): $43 EW 30A to $50 FHU 50A + tax, 4 people included, $6 each extra up to 8; 90 sites (50 FHU, 24 EW, tents, cottage); showers/laundry/store/wifi; reservable on its own form; Good Sam and military 10% confirmed on the operator's form. Google 4.5/357. Passes the price gate ($43) and presence.
flags: PRICE GATE: cheapest RV night $43 (electric/water 30A, before tax) on the operator's rate page dated 2025-02-01, under US$50; Good Sam 10% also offered. Presence: working website with phone 573-564-7993 and an online reservation form. Google Maps 4.5 over 357 reviews; RV Life 4* $$ (stored). Seasonal/long-term sites are sold too (seasonal $2,400 a year, 'not accepting seasonal reservations at this time'), but the operator leads with daily and weekend camping, events and tent sites - I don't read it as mostly seasonal; no site count for seasonals was found (the map PDF is an image).
